summary: The ConfidentialityForms class handles the management and processing of student confidentiality forms within the HSPnet enrollment system. It includes functionalities for adding, updating, and deleting records, as well as managing UI components for user interaction.
purpose: To provide a user interface and backend logic for managing confidentiality form data for students within an enrollment system.

workflows.name: ManageConfidentialityForms
steps: Handle data selection and population in gridData
Manage updates and submissions through gridDataEdit
Perform add or update operations using controller methods
Bind data changes and update interface elements
Handle user commands such as Save, Edit, and Delete

conditions: If UserSession is null, cancel data operations
Disable UI controls based on RowDisabled, ActionDisabled, and blnReadOnly flags
Show or hide buttons based on user permissions and data conditions
system_behavior: Update UI components dynamically based on user interaction
Manage session and user data to control access and actions
Handle asynchronous postbacks to maintain UI state
